notes.title: v2.0.2
notes.content:
[h1][b][list]
[*] - Fixed a small view when the game launch where the loading will show only after few second.
[*] - fixed Game Windows size to load when the game is at loading screen instead in the level game.
[*] - Fixed some icon size.
[*] - Added a box to purchase legendary item inside of the game with quantity.
[*] - Added the store button inside of the new box instead of the icon from the left menu.
[/list]

If its not made dont forget to leave a review on the store page.[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]"We apologize for reverting to the old version, but we have fixed some issues. The online feature has been removed, and the clicker is back with the leaderboard and everything as before. We've also fixed the inventory, adding a button to enable and disable erase mode so it's not always activated. Once again, we're sorry for the online feature; we thought it was a good idea."[/b][/h1]

- 3d environement movement
- multiplayer online
- add your item on your character and show it to the world!
- no more clic just join a game and wait the drop will trigger itself
